references.text: Also warns against forgetting the Lord who brought the people out of Egypt, the same theme of not forgetting the covenant
Exhortation to guard against forgetting the Lord and His commands, laws, and statutes
Warning about the consequences of forgetting the Lord and following other gods
The prohibition against making carved images or any representation, the basis for the prohibition mentioned in Deuteronomy
Prohibition against making idols or carved images
Earlier in the same chapter, a detailed prohibition against making carved images of any creature
A curse on anyone who makes a carved or cast image, an abomination to the Lord
Joshua's exhortation not to break the covenant and serve other gods
Refers to the covenant God made with the fathers when He brought them out of Egypt
Prophetic warning that the people will forget the covenant and turn to other gods
